title: Winter and Harvest
author: Quentin Ishikawa
blurb: Mirabel Blackwood, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
